visual_reference.applies_throughout: Cinematography and character-archetype homage only -- tight hardened-realism framing, high-contrast compositions favoring faces/body language, weighted staging, moral-weight-of-choices character register. Story stays contemporary, stays in Santa Ana.
visual_reference.literal_period_styling_note: seq_01: only Beat 1.14 (Earl's Ghost flashback). seq_02: the full sequence (arrest through prison), reverting to contemporary styling for the sequence's closing job-interview beats. Period styling is a deliberate stylistic choice, not literal in-story chronology.

render_technique.name: ca_dissolved_pixel_focus
render_technique.summary: Chunky black-and-white pixel-art base render, upscaled and edge-relaxed via the project's existing cellular automata engine (fung_ai_v2/ca_engine.py step_ca) as a depth-of-field stand-in: near-zero CA iterations on face regions (stays crisp/focal), progressively more iterations with distance from faces (dissolves into soft organic shapes). Reuses the same CA smoothing already used for cave-wall generation, applied to rendered pixels instead of terrain.

age_state_coverage.age_15: The Setup present-day timeline (seq_01) + covers the teen-arrest beat opening seq_02
age_state_coverage.age_27: Covers 21yo framing/prison through the rest of the film (seq_02 close through seq_07). Two wardrobe/environment passes needed within this single design: prison-era (period-styled, seq_02) and contemporary (seq_03 onward) -- same character sprite base, different costuming, not a separate age variant.

design_reference_notes.age_7: User-supplied personal photo reference (not stored in repo -- real identifiable individual, kept out of version control). Style notes for the age-7 design: tight cornrows/braided hairstyle, light blue/grey pullover hoodie, casual everyday streetwear, direct wide-eyed candid expression, slim youthful build. Note: reference photo's subject looks visually older than 7 -- user directed this look apply to the age-7 design regardless; treat as an intentional stylistic choice, not a literal age match.
design_reference_notes.age_27: User-supplied reference images (not stored in repo). Two moods identified: (1) intense/serious close-up -- short low natural haircut, blue crew-neck shirt, gold/silver cross necklace, stud earrings both ears, direct unflinching eye contact; (2) prayerful/vulnerable -- same wardrobe, hands clasped near chin in a contemplative/anxious gesture, eyes closed or downcast, framed 'Last Supper' print visible in the background setting -- fits the redemption-arc emotional register (Collapse/Courtroom/Sand sequences). A third image (two men greeting/handshaking outdoors) is assumed to be a joint Pure(27)+Marcus rapport/relationship reference rather than a distinct third mood -- flag if that reading is wrong.

delia.age_lock_note: User confirmed: single design used across the entire film, no visibly-older second pass for seq_04 (The Collapse) onward despite years of in-story time passing. Resolves SEQUENCE_BREAKDOWN.md open question #2.
